items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the general municipal law, in relation to the municipal
sustainable energy loan program
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S1335

SPONSOR: PARKER
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the general municipal law, in relation to the municipal
sustainable energy loan program

 
PURPOSE:

To find and achieve statewide 5 energy efficiency and renewable energy
goals, reduce greenhouse gas emissions and mitigate the effect of global
climate change, and advance a clean energy economy

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1. to achieve such policy and goals the state must promote the
deployment of renewable energy systems  
AND, energy efficiency meas-
ures, qualifying water improvements, and low carbon intensity building
components

Section 2. for the purpose of determining the feasibility of installing
a renewable energy system or qualifying water improvement.

Section 3. Sustainable energy loan program. The legislative body of any
municipal corporation may, by local law, establish a sustainable energy
loan program using federal grant assistance or federal credit support or
monies from the state of New York or any state authority as defined by
section two of the public authorities' law available for this purpose.

Section 4. This act shall take effect immediately

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The legislative responsibility to find and create the most efficient and
economical ways to create a new sustainable energy loan programs that
allows for the structuring and dispersion of the most sensible ways to
deploy new generation and clean energy programs related to but not
limited too such.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

Discoverable through study

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately
